references.text: Concerns how to test a prophet who gives signs and wonders, to see if he leads the people away from the Lord
Jeremiah confronts the false prophet Hananiah and shows how a true prophet is confirmed when his words come to pass
Ezekiel warns against false prophets who prophesy from their own hearts without having received a word from the Lord
The following verse gives the answer to the question: a word that does not come to pass has not been spoken by the Lord
The Lord warns against listening to prophets who speak visions from their own hearts and not from the mouth of the Lord
John urges believers to test the spirits to see if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world
